name: Conjurer’s Burden
body:
School abjuration; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, medium 2, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components: V, S, M/DF (a broken stick of chalk)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one called or summoned creature
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You make a conjured creature more difficult for casters to control, whether by the spell that conjured it or by other means. If a summoned target fails its Will save, it can only make a single standard action each round unless the conjurer concentrates on it as a standard action. It gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against the spells and abilities of its summoner, and the DC its summoner’s skill checks and caster level checks made to control it increase by 4. An unwilling target can attempt a new Will saving throw once per hour to end the spell’s effects. If you target a called creature, the creature may attempt a new saving throw against the DC of the spell that called it. If successful, it can return home immediately.

If the target’s hit dice exceed your caster level, this spell fails.
